name: EHDSMedicationDispense
title: Medication dispense model
description: Logical model for medication dispensation (based on a request and dispensed in a pharmacy). Implementers should take into account, if allowed and needed, the calculation of remaining dispensable product based on this information.

element.short: Medication dispense model
element.definition: Logical model for medication dispensation (based on a request and dispensed in a pharmacy). Implementers should take into account, if allowed and needed, the calculation of remaining dispensable product based on this information.

element.short: Dispensation header.
element.definition: Dispensation header.

element.short: Patient/subject information.
element.definition: The person for whom the medication is prescribed.

element.short: Business identifier for the dispensation.
element.definition: Business identifier(s) for the dispense record.
element.comment: Business identifier is unique within the system that assigns them. The same entity may have different unique identifiers assigned by different systems. Therefore, the identifier is always expected to be a pair of a system and a value.

element.short: Author of the document.
element.definition: The actor who issued the dispense record. Responsibility for the dispense should be traceable from this information.
element.comment: Author(s) responsible for the provided information. The exact role of the responsible author varies across use cases and is specific to individual models.

element.short: Indicator that states, when included with value ‘true’, that the contents of this resource represent information inserted by the natural person or their representative. In this case, the contents shall not be considered as verified by a health professional or a healthcare provider, even if digitally signed by them as part of a bigger data set. Details of the person who inserted the information may be provided in the author[x] element.
